seoTitle: Statistics Calculator: Mean, SD, Variance, Quartiles, z-Score
metaDescription: Paste numbers and get count, mean, median, mode, sample and population standard deviation and variance, quartiles, IQR, outliers and z-scores.
intro: Describe a data set quickly, with both sample and population formulas.
why:
Numbers can be separated by commas, spaces or new lines. The page reports count, sum, minimum, maximum, range, mean, median and mode, sample (n-1) and population (n) variance and standard deviation, the standard error of the mean, mean absolute deviation, quartiles with the inclusive (Excel QUARTILE.INC) method, the interquartile range and outliers beyond 1.5 times the IQR, plus a z-score for a value you choose. Results were checked against Python's statistics module.

Quartile methods differ between tools (inclusive, exclusive, Tukey hinges), so numbers may differ slightly from another program.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Optionally enter a value for its z-score.
Use the sample standard deviation for data that is a sample of a larger group.

faq.a: Use the sample formulas (n-1) when your data is a sample of a larger population, population formulas when it is the whole group.
